sim_lod.comment: Simulation level of detail. A career only needs full fidelity where the player can actually be seen, scouted or signed. Everything else is a cheaper statistical model that still produces legal tables, transfers and history.

deep.description: Full match engine, individual player states, injuries, morale, coach market, scouting dossiers.
deep.applies_to: the player's own division, plus one division above and below it, plus every T1/T2 in the packs above

medium.description: Aggregate match model, squad-level form, real transfers, no per-minute events.
medium.applies_to: remaining modelled divisions in loaded packs

shallow.description: Table + goal distribution only. Clubs still exist as scouting/transfer destinations.

sim_lod.promotion_rule: A division is promoted to `deep` the moment the player, an active suitor club, or a tracked rival is in it. Demotion back to `medium` waits 2 seasons so recent history stays queryable.

continental_slots.comment: How many clubs each country sends. Israeli clubs realistically compete for the third-tier continental trophy — which is exactly the career hook: a Ligat ha'Al season CAN put you on a European night against a Ligue 1 side.

transfer_corridors.comment: Realistic movement pressure between markets. A corridor weight of 1.0 is 'normal'; higher means AI clubs and scouts look here more often. This is what makes an Israeli career feel like a real ladder rather than a dead end — Ligat ha'Al genuinely feeds Belgium/Portugal/Cyprus-type markets and, for the best, straight into a top-5 second tier.

corridors.note: Rare and reputation-gated: needs continental minutes or a national-team call-up.

career_start_presets.comment: The starting points the Creator offers. Each is a different difficulty and a different story shape, not just a different club.

presets.hook: מוקף בכישרון. הבעיה אינה יכולת אלא דקות.
דלת פתוחה לסגל הבוגר — אם תתאים לשיטה.
ליגה קטנה, חלון קטן: להיראות באירופה תוך שלוש עונות.
אין חוזה. יש מבחנים, סוכן חלש ושלושה חודשים.
בן 23, חצי־מקצוען. הגוף בשיא, הזמן קצר.
שפה חדשה, חדר הלבשה קר, פוטנציאל גבוה.

identity_licensing.comment: ClubIdentity is stored separately from ClubSimulation on purpose. Swapping this block changes what the player SEES; it never touches AI, saves or balance.

real_names_generic_marks.risk: Club names and competition names are trademarks. Fine for development and private builds; requires legal review or licensing before commercial release. See docs/05_DATA_AND_LICENSING_HE.md.

fully_fictional.club_names: generated from the city/region corpus, preserving reputation and pyramid position

identity_licensing.switch_cost: Zero. Mode is read at world load; a save started in one mode opens in another with identical simulation state.
